name: Gon Freecss
description: A cheerful, athletic boy from Whale Island who takes the Hunter Exam to find his father Ging, a legendary Hunter who left when Gon was an infant. His honesty and stubborn determination win over friends and rivals alike. He is an Enhancer, channeling his aura into raw physical power through his signature technique Jajanken.

name: Killua Zoldyck
description: The third son of the infamous Zoldyck assassin family, trained from birth to kill but longing for an ordinary childhood. He runs away from home, takes the Hunter Exam, and becomes Gon's closest friend. A Transmuter, he changes his aura into electricity, drawing on a lifetime of resistance to torture and shock.

name: Kurapika
description: The last survivor of the Kurta Clan, whose people were massacred by the Phantom Troupe for their scarlet eyes. He becomes a Hunter to recover his clan's stolen eyes and take revenge on the Troupe. A Conjurer who materializes chains on his right hand, he becomes a Specialist when his eyes turn scarlet, letting him use all Nen categories at full strength.

name: Leorio Paradinight
name_ja: レオリオ＝パラディナイト
description: A brash, money-obsessed exam rookie whose greed turns out to mask a generous heart: he wants a Hunter license to fund medical school and treat the poor for free. Loud and quick to quarrel but fiercely loyal, he becomes one of Gon's first and truest friends. He is an Emitter, though his Nen is revealed only late in the series.

name: Hisoka Morow
description: A flamboyant, magician-themed fighter who lives for battles against strong opponents, sparing promising 'unripe fruit' like Gon so they can grow into worthy prey. Utterly unpredictable, he switches between ally and enemy as his amusement dictates. A Transmuter, he gives his aura the properties of both rubber and gum with his ability Bungee Gum.

name: Illumi Zoldyck
description: The eldest son of the Zoldyck assassin family and Killua's coldly controlling older brother, who first appears at the Hunter Exam disguised under the alias Gittarackur. Emotionless and single-minded, he believes Killua's only purpose is to be an assassin. A Manipulator, he controls people with his signature Nen-imbued needles.

name: Isaac Netero
description: Isaac Netero was the 12th Chairman of the Hunter Association and Head of the Exam Commission for the 287th Hunter Exam. In his youth he was extolled as the world's most powerful Nen user, and even in old age he retained dreadful strength beneath a playful, eccentric demeanor. He personally tests Gon and Killua during the Hunter Exam and later leads the Association's most dangerous operation against the Chimera Ants.

name: Hanzo
description: A shinobi from Jappon who takes the Hunter Exam to find the lost Hermit's Scroll of his ninja clan. Talkative and boastful but a genuinely elite martial artist, he passes the exam and becomes a professional Hunter. His speed and hand-to-hand skill make him one of the strongest rookies of his exam year.

name: Tonpa
description: A pudgy perennial Hunter Exam applicant infamous as the 'Rookie Crusher' for sabotaging promising first-timers, most notoriously by offering them laxative-spiked juice. He has failed the exam dozens of times, having decided that crushing newcomers is more satisfying than passing. Despite his schemes, he is quickly seen through by Gon's group.

name: Pokkle
description: An archer who reaches the Final Phase of the 287th Hunter Exam on his second try, paralyzing his Zevil Island target with a poisoned arrow. He passes only because Killua concedes their match, a default win that nags at his pride. An Emitter, he later fires arrows of aura as a Hunter of Fantastic Beasts, until his expedition into NGL runs into the Chimera Ants.

name: Ponzu
description: A quiet, analytical examinee in a wide hat who stalks her Zevil Island target with sleeping gas, then finds herself trapped in his snake-filled cave. The bees she keeps under her hat sting Bourbon to death, and Leorio, Gon and Kurapika have to rescue her. A Manipulator who commands her swarm, she later joins Pokkle's NGL expedition and is among the first to spot the Chimera Ants.

name: Satotz
description: A tall, mustachioed Ruins Hunter who proctors the First Phase of the 287th Hunter Exam, leading four hundred applicants on a silent marathon through the Zaban tunnel and the Milsy Wetlands. He never runs, only walks, and still nobody can catch him. Calm and perceptive, he senses Hisoka's menace early, takes a quiet liking to Gon, and admits he would love to meet Ging.

name: Menchi
description: A Single-Star Gourmet Hunter and celebrated chef who co-proctors the Second Phase of the 287th Hunter Exam, demanding sushi from applicants who have never heard of it and failing every one of them. Her temper flares when Todo insults Gourmet Hunters, and Chairman Netero has to talk her into a retest: diving for Spider Eagle eggs. Fiercely picky, she never forgets the taste of anything she has eaten.

name: Buhara
description: An enormous, easygoing Gourmet Hunter who co-proctors the Second Phase of the 287th Hunter Exam alongside Menchi. His task sounds simple, roast pork, but the only pigs in the Visca Forest Preserve are the ferocious Great Stamps, and he cheerfully eats all seventy dishes the survivors bring back. When Todo charges at Menchi, one palm strike from Buhara sends the wrestler into a wall, which he insists saved the man's life.

name: Lippo
description: A Blacklist Hunter and prison warden who runs the Third and Fourth Phases of the 287th Hunter Exam. Inside Trick Tower he pits applicants against his own convicts, promising each prisoner a year off their sentence for every hour they stall, and snacks contentedly in front of the monitors as the games play out. He then sends the survivors to Zevil Island for a week-long badge hunt, assigning targets by lottery.

name: Beans
description: Chairman Netero's small, green-skinned secretary, who hands out badges at the 287th Hunter Exam, relays each phase's instructions from the Association airship, and briefs the new Hunters on what their licenses can do. Dutiful and unflappable, he has worked beside Netero for two decades and still cannot say how old the man is. After the Chairman's death he carries out his last wishes, steering the Zodiacs toward the election.

name: Mito Freecss
description: Gon's aunt and the woman who raised him on Whale Island after taking custody from her cousin Ging. She keeps house with her grandmother, hides the truth about Gon's father to keep the boy home, and only signs his Hunter Exam application after he catches the Master of the Swamp. Warm, stubborn and easily flustered, she cannot lie to Gon without avoiding his eyes.

name: Kiriko
description: A family of shape-shifting Magical Beasts who live by the Lone Pine outside Dolle Harbor and serve as navigators to the Hunter Exam. They test Gon, Kurapika and Leorio by staging an attack on a human couple, and are won over by Gon's senses, Kurapika's knowledge and Leorio's kindness. Winged, clawed and fluent in human speech, they later guide Killua to his retake, and their son stands in for Gotoh.

name: Bodoro
description: An elderly martial artist, examinee #191, who reaches the Final Phase of the 287th Hunter Exam with a personal code that forbids him from fighting children. Hisoka beats him easily, then whispers something that makes him surrender on the spot. His next match against Leorio never truly begins: Killua, under his brother Illumi's influence, kills him from behind and walks out of the exam.

name: Geretta
description: A huntsman, examinee #384, who tracks Gon across Zevil Island for days without being noticed, waiting until the boy finally snatches Hisoka's badge with his fishing rod. One dart from his blowgun then drops Gon with a muscle relaxant, and he pockets both badges while lecturing his target on the seven thousand chances he had to kill him. His own hunter is Hisoka, who returns to Gon carrying Geretta's head.

name: Bendot
description: A hulking robber and murderer serving 199 years in Trick Tower, the first of five prisoners Lippo sets against Gon's group in the Third Phase of the 287th Hunter Exam. He proposes a fight to the death or surrender, and Tonpa concedes the instant the match begins, leaving him bored and annoyed. Loud and eager to brawl, he still knows his limits, backing away from Killua after watching him kill Johness.

name: Sedokan
description: A soft-spoken serial bomber, 149 years into his Trick Tower sentence, who admits he is no fighter and challenges Gon to a candle contest instead: whoever's flame goes out first loses. His long candle turns out to be rigged to burn fast, but Gon simply sprints with it until the trick fizzles, blows out Sedokan's flame, and wins. Patient and calculating, he counts on his opponents wasting time.

name: Majtani
description: A scarred, muscle-bound Trick Tower prisoner who greets Kurapika with a chest full of tattooed hearts, a supposed kill count, and a Phantom Troupe spider inked on his back. The spider is a fake, but it still sends Kurapika's eyes scarlet; one punch later Majtani lies unconscious. A coward and fraud beneath the theatrics, he then plays dead to run out the clock.

name: Leroute
description: A cheerful gambler and wildlife trafficker who keeps her hood on until she has Leorio at the betting table, wagering hours of the examinees' remaining time against years of her own sentence. She bets on whether Majtani is dead, whether she is a woman, and finally on rock-paper-scissors, reading Leorio's mind well enough to strip fifty hours from Gon's group. A flawless poker face hides a sharp, manipulative psychologist.

name: Johness the Dissector
description: Zaban City's most infamous mass murderer, a Trick Tower prisoner serving nearly a thousand years for dismembering victims with his bare hands, and the last opponent Gon's group must beat to descend. Facing Killua, he cares nothing for the exam; he just wants to feel flesh tear again. Killua ends it in a blink, plucking out his heart and crushing it while Johness pleads to have it back.

name: Siper
description: A stoic markswoman, examinee #80, who carries a rifle through the 287th Hunter Exam and is one of the twenty-four to reach Zevil Island. The lottery hands her Gittarackur's badge, and she lines up a long-range shot at the pin-headed stranger. It is the last thing she does: Gittarackur, annoyed at the attempt on his life, kills her and hands her badge over to Hisoka.

name: Cherry
description: A veteran martial artist, examinee #76, marked by Tonpa as an old hand at the Hunter Exam. Running the First Phase beside Todo, he remarks that only one applicant has dropped out so far. In the Milsy Wetlands, Hisoka turns on the group he is running with; Cherry, Kurapika and Leorio scatter, and only two of them get away. His body is left hanging from a tree.

name: Todo
description: A wrestler, examinee #255, who wants to be a Blacklist Hunter and sees no reason a Hunter should need to cook. When Menchi fails every applicant, he smashes his kitchen and charges her, only for Buhara to swat him into a wall with one palm. Smarter than he looks, he refuses to jump for Spider Eagle eggs, asks Gon for a taste, and vows to return next year.

name: Sommy
description: A sly examinee who never goes anywhere without his trained monkey and reaches the Fourth Phase of the 287th Hunter Exam. On Zevil Island he teams up with Tonpa, swapping target sheets to trick Leorio, and his monkey snatches Leorio's badge from behind while Sommy sneers at the man's stupidity. Kurapika and Leorio hunt him down, take back the badge and his own, and end his exam.

name: Agon
description: A left-handed fencer, examinee #281, who survives Trick Tower only to draw Hisoka as his hunter on Zevil Island. Cornered, he refuses to run: he pulls his rapier, taunts the magician and lunges. Gon, hidden nearby, chooses that instant to hook Hisoka's badge with his fishing rod, catching both men off guard; Hisoka's cards cut Agon down moments later.

name: Nicholas
description: A young prodigy, examinee #187, who tops every class and competition back home and arrives at the 287th Hunter Exam with a laptop full of applicant data, enough to spot Tonpa as a rookie crusher and refuse his drink. The First Phase marathon is another matter: near the eighty-kilometer mark his legs give out, the Amori brothers circle to mock him, and he becomes the first applicant to drop out.

name: Katzo
description: A frail young crewman on the ship that carries Gon, Kurapika and Leorio from Whale Island toward Dolle Harbor. When a storm hits mid-voyage and a broken spar flings him overboard, the three applicants catch him together, Gon lunging over the rail and the other two grabbing Gon's legs. The rescue ends Kurapika and Leorio's quarrel before their fight can start, and earns all three the captain's respect.

name: Bourbon
description: The Snake Charmer, examinee #103, a Hunter Exam veteran whom Tonpa warns is tenacious and dangerous to cross. On Zevil Island he hides deep in a cave and orders his snakes to bite anyone who enters or touches him, planning to trade antidotes for badges. Ponzu's bees find him first, and he dies of an allergic reaction to their stings; his snakes keep guarding the cave, trapping Ponzu and nearly killing Leorio.

name: Amori
description: The eldest Amori brother, examinee #197, one of three exam regulars whose whole game is teamwork. Paid by Tonpa, they circle the exhausted Nicholas in the First Phase and mock him until he quits. On Zevil Island the brothers form up against Killua, who drops Amori from behind and holds a claw to his throat until Umori surrenders his badge. A year later they try again and Killua flattens them in seconds.

name: Umori
description: The middle Amori brother, examinee #199, as cocky as Amori and quick to punch Imori when the youngest hesitates. On Zevil Island he and Amori bag their targets' badges while Imori stalls on Killua, and his #199 badge turns out to be exactly the one Killua needs. With a claw at Amori's throat, he hands it over without a fight, and the brothers fail again at the 288th exam.

name: Imori
description: The youngest Amori brother, examinee #198, loud when his brothers are beside him and timid the moment he is alone. Assigned Killua's badge on Zevil Island, he shadows the boy for hours without daring to strike, then makes excuses when Amori and Umori return. Pushed into attacking, he loses his badge in a single exchange, and Killua tosses it into the forest for him to find.

name: Goz
description: A spearman, examinee #371, who fights his way through Trick Tower to Zevil Island, where Gittarackur leaves him mortally wounded. Rather than bleed out quietly, he stumbles upon Hisoka and demands a duel, felling a tree with a single swing despite his wounds. Hisoka only dodges, declaring he has no interest in the dead, and Gittarackur finishes him, calling it the granting of a last wish.

name: Silva Zoldyck
description: The current head of the Zoldyck Family of assassins and Killua's father. A towering figure with immense physical strength and vast reserves of aura, he has survived direct encounters with the Phantom Troupe. Though a cold professional, he shows a measured, calculating regard for his children and expects Killua to one day inherit the family business.

name: Kikyo Zoldyck
name_ja: キキョウ＝ゾルディック
description: Matriarch of the Zoldyck assassin family and Silva's wife, she runs the household on Kukuroo Mountain from behind a veil of bandages and a feathered hat. A Manipulator, she is an elite assassin in her own right, dropping Canary with a single dart flicked from her fan. She smothers Killua with a warped devotion, beaming with pride whenever he says something cruel to her.

name: Milluki Zoldyck
description: The second Zoldyck son, a hulking shut-in who has not left the estate since he was ten and does his assassin's work remotely from a room stacked with computers and figurines. A Manipulator by type, his real weapons are hacking and gadgetry; he built Killua's fifty-kilogram yo-yos. He whips his little brother in the family dungeon, then folds instantly the moment Killua threatens his figurine collection.

name: Kalluto Zoldyck
description: The youngest Zoldyck child, a quiet kimono-clad boy so often mistaken for a girl, who first appears silently trailing his mother around the estate. A Manipulator, he fights with a paper fan sharpened by aura and sends confetti and paper dolls to spy on and slice his targets. He later takes Hisoka's vacant seat in the Phantom Troupe as member number four, hoping to bring a brother home.

name: Canary
description: An apprentice butler of the Zoldyck Family who guards the approach to the estate on Kukuroo Mountain. She first appears repelling intruders with her staff when Gon comes to bring Killua home, turning away even armed bounty hunters with ease. Beneath her dutiful exterior she is fiercely loyal to Killua and genuinely cares for him, later assisting him during the election arc.

name: Gotoh
description: Senior butler of the Zoldyck estate, the stern, bespectacled voice that answers when anyone phones the mountain, and the man the family trusts with Killua's upbringing. An Enhancer, he flicks coins from his thumbs faster than bullets and tests Gon's group with a coin-guessing game with Canary's life as the stake. Beneath the protocol he loves Killua like a son, and dies protecting him from Hisoka.

name: Zebro
description: The elderly groundskeeper at the Zoldyck front gate, who looks like a gatekeeper but is really the janitor who sweeps up whatever the guard dog Mike leaves of intruders. He keeps in shape with twenty-kilogram slippers and a phone to match, and can still heave open the first door of the four-ton Testing Gate. He takes a shine to Gon's group and quietly houses them while they train to enter.

name: Seaquant
description: A gruff Blacklist Hunter who once stormed Kukuroo Mountain with a hundred men, watched a ten-year-old Canary flatten them all, and begged to work for the Zoldycks instead. Now Zebro's housemate and fellow groundskeeper, he never shows Nen but is strong enough to pass the Testing Gate. He finds the whole family too uncanny for words, yet spots Hunter potential in Gon, Kurapika and Leorio.

name: Mike
description: The Zoldyck family's enormous guard dog, a hound the size of a house that patrols the grounds inside the Testing Gate under one standing order, unchanged for ten years: kill every intruder. Trained to a machine-like blankness, it memorizes each stranger's face and scent and obeys no one but the Zoldycks themselves. Gon, raised among wild beasts, admits outright that Mike scares him.

name: Hishita
description: A minor Zoldyck butler in Gotoh's retinue who first appears at the servants' quarters during the coin-guessing game, where Gon's final, correct guess is that Hishita is the one palming the coin. He has no shown Nen ability but, like every Zoldyck servant, is strong enough to pass the Testing Gate. Later he chauffeurs Killua and Alluka toward Gon's hospital, only to reveal that Illumi's needle has him too.

name: Coco Loo
description: The perky guide for Lamentation Tours, whose bus carries gawking tourists, and Gon, Kurapika and Leorio, up Kukuroo Mountain to the Zoldyck front gate. She recites the family facts like a script: ten assassins in residence, from a great-great-grandfather down to five children, and the whole mountain their property. When two thugs force the gate and come back as skeletons, she flees with her tour, leaving the three boys behind.

name: Machi Komacine
description: Machi Komacine is member #3 of the Phantom Troupe, ranked sixth in physical strength among the group. Cool-headed and terse, she is known for her remarkably reliable intuition and her loyalty to the Troupe's leader. A Transmuter, she turns her aura into Nen threads strong enough to stitch severed limbs back together, a skill Hisoka pays her for at Heavens Arena.

name: Wing
description: Wing is an Assistant Master of Shingen-ryu kung fu, Zushi's teacher, and a former student of Biscuit Krueger. At Heavens Arena he becomes Gon and Killua's first true Nen teacher, initiating them into the discipline and overseeing their early training. Mild-mannered and scholarly, he takes his responsibility as a teacher very seriously.

name: Zushi
description: Zushi is a young Heavens Arena fighter and a practitioner of Shingen-ryu kung fu under his teacher Wing; before Gon and Killua, he was Wing's only student. He befriends the two at the Arena, and his surprising resilience from early Nen training first alerts Killua that there is a deeper power to learn. Earnest and disciplined, he steadily climbs the Arena's floors.

name: Kastro
description: A celebrated Heavens Arena fighter one win short of Floor Master, the only man ever to take points off Hisoka, and burning to avenge that lone defeat. An Enhancer, he pairs Tiger Bite Fist with a conjured double that lets him strike from two places at once, even tearing off Hisoka's arm in their rematch. Hisoka calmly diagnoses the fatal flaw before finishing him: memory overload.

name: Gido
description: A Heavens Arena fighter who lost his legs being 'initiated' into Nen and now, with Sadaso and Riehlvelt, preys on 200th-floor newcomers who barely know it. An Enhancer, he whirls on a single peg leg and hurls aura-charged Dancing Tops, ten at a time, that break Gon's arm in his debut. He kidnaps Zushi to force a rematch, and Gon's Ren shatters his tops in it.

name: Riehlvelt
description: A wheelchair-bound Heavens Arena fighter, paralyzed from the waist down by the aura attack that 'initiated' him into Nen, who hunts easy wins alongside Gido and Sadaso. He fights from a motorized chair with Twin Snakes, black whips that discharge a million volts, and blasts himself clear of danger with bursts of aura. Killua catches the whips barehanded, shrugs off the shock, and Riehlvelt faints before it can be returned.

name: Sadaso
description: A one-armed Heavens Arena fighter who stalks the 200th floor with Gido and Riehlvelt, picking off Nen novices for the wins that make a Floor Master. A Transmuter, he shapes his aura into a huge invisible arm in place of the one he lost, clamping a victim silent and breathless, and snatches Zushi hostage with it. Ten minutes before facing Killua, a knife at his skull persuades him to quit the Arena forever.

name: Cocco
description: The Heavens Arena's ringside commentator, a bright-eyed announcer who calls every 200th-floor bout with breathless enthusiasm, reeling off the fighters' records as they walk out. She has no Nen; her weapon is the microphone, turning each Clean Hit, Down and Critical into a shout for the crowd. She narrates Gon's debut against Gido's tops and Hisoka's brutal rematch with Kastro.

name: Chrollo Lucilfer
description: Chrollo Lucilfer is the founder, leader, and member #0 of the Phantom Troupe, and the main antagonist of the Yorknew City arc. Calm, cultured, and charismatic, he hails from Meteor City and values the Troupe's survival above his own life. As a Specialist, his Skill Hunter ability lets him steal other people's Nen abilities and store them in a conjured book called Bandit's Secret.

name: Nobunaga Hazama
description: Nobunaga Hazama is member #1 of the Phantom Troupe, ranked ninth in physical strength among the group. A samurai-styled swordsman and close friend of Uvogin, he is emotional and hot-blooded compared to his colleagues, and takes a liking to Gon during the Yorknew City arc. He is an Enhancer whose iaido draw-cut strikes anything entering the radius of his En.

name: Feitan Portor
description: Feitan Portor is member #2 of the Phantom Troupe, ranked fifth in physical strength among the group. Small and sadistic, he serves as the Troupe's interrogator and speaks in broken, terse sentences, often carrying an umbrella that conceals a hidden blade. He is a Transmuter whose aura grows more dangerous the more pain he suffers.

name: Shizuku Murasaki
description: Shizuku Murasaki is member #8 of the Phantom Troupe, ranked twelfth in physical strength among the group. Bespectacled and notoriously absent-minded, she often forgets people and events entirely, yet remains a dependable and loyal member. As a Conjurer, she summons a living vacuum cleaner nicknamed Blinky that can suck up limitless amounts of non-living things.

name: Franklin Bordeau
name_ja: フランクリン＝ボルドー
description: Franklin Bordeau is member #7 of the Phantom Troupe, ranked fourth in physical strength among the group. A hulking, stitched figure resembling Frankenstein's monster, he is nonetheless one of the Troupe's most level-headed and pragmatic voices. As an Emitter, his Double Machine Gun ability fires barrages of aura bullets from his fingertips, which he cut off to boost its power.

name: Phinks Magcub
description: Phinks Magcub is member #5 of the Phantom Troupe, ranked second in physical strength among the group. Recognizable by his Egyptian-styled outfits and tracksuit, he is short-tempered and blunt but fiercely loyal, often paired with Feitan. He is an Enhancer whose Ripper Cyclotron multiplies the power of his punch with every wind-up rotation of his arm.

name: Shalnark
description: Shalnark is member #6 of the Phantom Troupe and also a licensed Hunter, ranked tenth in physical strength among the group. Cheerful and tech-savvy, he acts as the Troupe's researcher and planner, digging up intelligence with his phone and Hunter website access. A Manipulator, his Black Voice ability lets him control anyone he tags with his antennas via phone commands, and he can plant one in himself for a devastating autopilot mode.

name: Uvogin
description: Uvogin was member #11 of the Phantom Troupe and physically the strongest in the group. A hulking Enhancer, he fought with raw hand-to-hand destruction, boasting that no ordinary attack could pierce his hardened body. He plays a central role in the Troupe's rampage through Yorknew City, where his clash with Kurapika becomes a turning point of the arc.

name: Pakunoda
description: Pakunoda was member #9 of the Phantom Troupe and its interrogator. Her Specialist ability let her read the memories of anyone she touched or questioned, and with her Memory Bomb she could conjure a revolver to fire those memories into others. Deeply loyal to leader Chrollo Lucilfer, she becomes pivotal during the Troupe's confrontation with Gon, Killua, and Kurapika in Yorknew City.

name: Zeno Zoldyck
description: Killua's grandfather and a legendary assassin of the Zoldyck Family, regarded as one of the deadliest killers alive. Despite his profession he is affable and pragmatic, treating killing strictly as business rather than pleasure. He clashes with Chrollo Lucilfer in Yorknew City and later joins the assault on the Chimera Ant palace, where his draconic aura techniques like Dragon Head and Dragon Dive are on full display.

name: Ging Freecss
description: Ging Freecss is the father of Gon Freecss, a Double-Star Ruins Hunter regarded as one of the greatest Hunters alive, and one of the creators of the game Greed Island. He left Gon on Whale Island to pursue his work, and finding him is Gon's whole motivation for becoming a Hunter. Elusive and eccentric, he appears mostly through recordings and flashbacks until stepping into the open during the 13th Chairman Election.

name: Bonolenov Ndongo
description: Member #10 of the Phantom Troupe, a bandaged, boxing-gloved warrior of the vanished Gyudondond tribe who joins the Yorknew auction heist and the massacre around the Cemetery Building. His body is riddled with holes that whistle as he dances, and each song is a Nen technique: his Conjuration-based Battle Cantabile materializes warrior garb and a spear. Formal and proud, he later hunts Chimera Ants in Meteor City with the Troupe.

name: Kortopi
description: Member #12 of the Phantom Troupe, a tiny thief with one enormous eye peering out from a mop of hair and the weakest physical strength in the group. A Conjurer, his Gallery Fake copies anything his left hand touches into a perfect replica from his right, letting the Troupe sell counterfeit auction loot and fake their own corpses. Quiet and loyal, he goes along with whatever the other Spiders decide.

name: Neon Nostrade
description: The spoiled teenage daughter of Mafia boss Light Nostrade and the client Kurapika is hired to guard in Yorknew City. She collects human body parts and throws tantrums whenever she is denied a shopping trip or an auction prize. A Specialist who never trained in Nen, she writes eerily accurate monthly fortunes as poems through Lovely Ghostwriter, the ability behind her father's rise, until Chrollo steals it from her.

name: Light Nostrade
description: Head of the Nostrade Family and Kurapika's employer, a mustached Mafia capo who rose from a small gang to the Ten Dons' favor by selling his daughter Neon's fortunes. He has no Nen of his own; his power is money and Neon's prophecies, so he spares no expense to keep her happy, buying the Scarlet Eyes for 2.9 billion. When her ability vanishes, he collapses into panic.

name: Dalzollene
description: Head of Neon Nostrade's bodyguards and Kurapika's first boss, a stern man with tattoos under his eyes who tests recruits with a locked room and disposes of guards who disobey him. Light claims he can shrug off ten bullets with Nen, yet his sabre snaps against Uvogin's aura when he interrogates the captured Spider. He hands the prisoner to fake Mafia men and is run through by Phinks.

name: Squala
description: The most senior of Neon's bodyguards, a curly-haired Nen user planted among the recruits as a second infiltrator until Kurapika's Dowsing Chain and Melody's ears expose him. A Manipulator, he controls a pack of dogs that guard, spy, run errands, and even talk in coded barks. He dreams of quitting the Mafia for Neon's attendant Eliza, and that love betrays him to Pakunoda and Nobunaga.

name: Baise
description: A Hunter hired as one of Neon Nostrade's new bodyguards, a coolly ruthless woman who uses the butler as a bullet shield during the recruitment test without a flicker of remorse. A Manipulator, her Instant Lover turns anyone she kisses into a devoted slave for 180 minutes, which she demonstrates on Squala with obvious enjoyment. Sent to the Underground Auction as a family representative, she dies in the Troupe's massacre.

name: Melody
description: A Music Hunter who becomes Kurapika's closest ally among the Nostrade bodyguards, small and kindly, her body deformed by hearing a single movement of the Sonata of Darkness. An Emitter, she pours aura into her flute to soothe and heal, and her supernatural ears read any heartbeat, exposing liars and confirming whether Killua is being manipulated. She hunts the Sonata to destroy it, and worries endlessly over Kurapika's rage.

name: Basho
description: A brash, pompadoured Hunter who joins Neon Nostrade's bodyguards alongside Kurapika and Melody and laughs it off when Kurapika tells him never to speak to him again. His Nen type is never stated; his Great Hiker ability makes a haiku brushed onto a slip of paper come true, setting liars ablaze during Squala's interrogation. He suffers through Neon's shopping sprees and later votes in the Chairman election.

name: Linssen
description: A Hunter and long-serving Nostrade bodyguard, a slender man in Chinese dress who guards the auction house's rear entrance with Basho on the night everything goes wrong. His Nen type is never shown, though he can use Gyo. Cautious to a fault, he argues against Kurapika's plan to capture Uvogin and is the one who spots the car tailing them out of the Gordeau Desert. He later votes in the Chairman election.

name: Zepile
description: A reformed counterfeiter turned antiques appraiser with enormous eyebrows who takes Gon and Killua under his wing in Yorknew's markets, spotting a treasure hidden inside a cheap wooden statue and helping them raise money for Greed Island. He has no formal Nen training, yet unknowingly poured aura into his forgeries. Genial and shrewd, he asks for a twenty percent cut and happily settles for lunch instead.

name: Pairo
description: Kurapika's closest childhood friend in the Kurta village, a gentle boy with failing eyes and weak legs after a fall from a cliff while saving Kurapika. Poised where Kurapika is hot-headed, he sees through the elder's hired thugs and earns his friend permission to seek the outside world and a cure. He has no Nen. Kurapika thinks of him before the hostage exchange, refusing to lose another friend.

name: Shachmono Tocino
name_ja: シャッチモーノ＝トチーノ
description: A Hunter and senior Nostrade bodyguard planted among the recruits to test them, sending eleven hooded gunmen and swordsmen against Kurapika, Melody, Basho, and Baise until Kurapika's knife at his throat makes him call them off. An Emitter, his Eleven Black Children inflates balloons with aura into life-sized puppets. At the Underground Auction he throws them up as a shield against Franklin's bullets and dies protecting his comrades.

name: Ivlenkov
description: A plump, quietly professional Nostrade bodyguard in a black suit who meets Neon's airship at Lingon Airport and is chosen with Tocino and Baise to represent the family at the Underground Auction. His Nen is never revealed, though he is agile enough to dodge Franklin's hail of aura bullets. Breaking down the door to escape, he runs straight into Shizuku, and his body vanishes into her vacuum, Blinky.

name: Worm
description: One of the Shadow Beasts, the Ten Dons' elite Nen enforcers, a red-skinned man reshaped into something like a giant worm who surfaces from the sand of the Gordeau Desert to confront Uvogin. Listed as a Transmuter, he burrows through earth without effort, striking from below and dragging prey underground. His punch breaks his own hand on Uvogin's face, and Big Bang Impact leaves only his arm behind.

name: Leech
description: A portly, sadistic Shadow Beast who arrives with Porcupine and Rabid Dog to finish Uvogin off in the Gordeau Desert. A Manipulator, he breeds flesh-eating leeches inside a sac in his body and feeds them into a wound through a trunk-like tongue, gleefully explaining how their eggs will hatch in the bladder and kill by pain alone. Uvogin answers by biting off the top of his head.

name: Porcupine
description: An apathetic Shadow Beast whose Nen turns his body hair into thousands of steel-hard needles that stop Uvogin's fist cold and tangle around it so it cannot be shaken free. Listed as a Transmuter, he claims the barrier would deflect even bullets, and he softens the spines at will to spare his allies. Needles cannot deflect sound, though: Uvogin's aura-charged scream bursts his eyes and ears.

name: Rabid Dog
description: A crass, grinning Shadow Beast with filed teeth who fights hit-and-run, darting in to bite chunks from Uvogin while his comrades hold the Spider's attention. An Enhancer, he sharpens his jaws and speed with aura, and his fangs inject a neurotoxin that paralyzes a victim from the neck down while leaving them awake to feel fear. Uvogin kills him by spitting a shard of Leech's skull through his hand and head.

name: Owl
description: A flip-flop-wearing Shadow Beast who empties the Underground Auction vault hours before the Phantom Troupe arrives, carrying every item away in his pocket. A Conjurer, his Fun Fun Cloth shrinks whatever it wraps, and he drops it over a speeding car to trap Nobunaga. The Troupe takes him alive and hands him to Feitan; Chrollo later steals the ability and uses it against Zeno and Silva Zoldyck.

name: Eliza
description: One of Neon Nostrade's two personal attendants, a calm young woman in a dark kimono who deals cards with her mistress, cleans up after her tantrums, and trails her through Yorknew's boutiques. She has no Nen and no fighting role; she keeps Neon hidden when trouble comes. She is quietly in love with the bodyguard Squala, and his death is what finally sends Neon home.

name: Zenji
description: A stocky, bald Mafia capo in tiny sunglasses who briefs the freelance assassins hired against the Phantom Troupe and openly resents Light Nostrade's rise. He has no Nen at all, only thugs and a pistol. He beats Light in front of Kurapika, sneers at the bodyguard as useless, and bids the Scarlet Eyes up to 2.9 billion. Gun in hand, he freezes when Kurapika's bloodlust washes over him.

name: Biscuit Krueger
name_ja: ビスケット＝クルーガー
description: Biscuit Krueger is a Double-Star Stone Hunter hired by Battera to clear the video game Greed Island, where she takes Gon and Killua on as her students. Despite her small, doll-like appearance she is a vastly experienced Nen master who is far stronger than she looks. Known as 'Bisky', she drills the boys mercilessly and shapes them into true Nen fighters.

name: Razor
description: A Game Master of Greed Island and one of its most powerful inhabitants, a former convict who helped Ging Freecss create the game. He administers the island's sports-themed challenges and confronts Gon's team in a lethal game of dodgeball. A supremely powerful Emitter, he launches Nen-charged balls with devastating force and fields emitted 'Devils' as his teammates.

name: Genthru
description: A ruthless Greed Island player known as the Bomber, who murders fellow players to steal their cards and clear the game for its grand prize. Publicly he poses as a trustworthy ally while secretly working with two accomplices. His conjured explosives, Little Flower and Countdown, make him the chief antagonist of Gon's time on the island and the opponent Gon trains specifically to defeat.

name: Sub
description: One of the three Bombers, the ruthless player-hunting trio led by Genthru that terrorizes Greed Island. Spiky red hair and a forehead tattoo mark him as he lurks in Zetsu, steals cards with a Tax Collector's Gauntlet, and speaks the keyword that detonates Countdown on an entire alliance. His own Nen ability is never shown. He is fiercely loyal to his teammates, and Bara once saves him from an arrow in the night.

name: Bara
description: The most volatile of the three Bombers, a long-haired, muscular enforcer with a trident tattoo who follows Genthru through Greed Island. He steals cards with a Tax Collector's Gauntlet, punches players who are slow to hand over spells, and helps blow Nickes' alliance to pieces. His own Nen ability is never revealed. Biscuit thrashes him in the final showdown, and he only laughs, sure she cannot finish him.

name: Tsezguerra
description: A Single-Star Jackpot Hunter and Battera's partner, who screens every Greed Island applicant by judging their Ren and leads a team of pro Hunters through the game. Gon and Killua fail his test, then pass it four days later, which quietly shakes him. He flies his team with Accompany and stalls the Bombers for three weeks. Their progress reminds him what earnest effort feels like, and he vows to start over from the basics.

name: Goreinu
description: A gruff, hairy-armed Hunter hired by Battera who ends up as the fourth member of Gon's team once the alliance against the Bombers falls apart. He commands two Nen gorillas: White Goreinu swaps places with him, Black Goreinu swaps places with an enemy, tricks that save the dodgeball match against Razor. Wary of working with kids, he grows fond enough to call Killua a friend and later visits Gon in the hospital.

name: Abengane
description: A quiet, dark-skinned Greed Island player who joins Nickes' alliance for the money and survives its massacre by pulling Genthru's bomb out of his own body. A Conjurer, he is a Nen exorcist: he summons a beast that swallows a curse and then has to carry it around. Calm even with a bomb ticking on his chest, he later takes a job from Hisoka to remove the Nen sealing Chrollo's abilities.

name: Battera
description: A multi-billionaire who spends half his fortune buying every copy of Greed Island at the Southernpiece Auction, hires Hunters to clear it, and promises fifty billion to whoever finishes. He tells reporters he wants the game for love, and means it: he hopes an in-game card can wake his fiancée from a long coma. When she dies, he cancels the reward and locks himself away, leaving the players stranded mid-game.

name: Barry
description: A freckled, muscular young Hunter on Tsezguerra's team, recognizable by the cap he wears sideways. He worries about how close the Bombers are to clearing the game after they steal his card monopolies, and takes over as the team's Accompany caster when Tsezguerra runs dry during the long chase. He mostly follows orders, patches up teammates after Razor's games, and later turns up to vote in the Chairman Election.

name: Kess
description: A tall, curly-haired Hunter on Tsezguerra's team and its tactical thinker, who proposes monopolizing Plot of Beach before the Bombers can reach it. His Nen ability Silent Worker conjures a radar that tracks a target anywhere on the island, the engine behind the team's hit-and-run ambushes on Genthru's trio. Impulsive enough to want to chase the Bombers right after they rob him, he wins his free-throw challenge against Razor's pirates.

name: Rodriot
description: A rotund, bandana-wearing Hunter on Tsezguerra's team and its most hot-headed member. He wins the bowling challenge against Razor's pirates, and later checks how many spells the Bombers have left by feeding a Chidon card to a Clairvoyant Snake. Alongside Kess and Barry he keeps the team alive through a weeks-long chase, then walks away from the game with Battera. He reappears to vote in the Chairman Election.

name: Kazsule
description: A tall Greed Island player in leopard print and fur who sneers that only fools enter the Antokiba tournaments, then keeps contacting Gon's team to trade cards. When the Bombers come within a few cards of finishing the game, he gathers fifteen players into an alliance to monopolize Plot of Beach and leads them to Soufrabi. His alliance loses every one of Razor's sports trials and disbands, and Genthru's trio kills him soon after.

name: Nickes
description: A scruffy, well-spoken Greed Island player who founds an alliance to beat the game by pooling cards instead of hunting players. He explains to Gon and Killua that no spell can kill, only Nen can, and recruits members with the promise of a shared fifty-billion prize and an end to the bloodshed. Genthru joins as a mole, plants Countdown bombs on every member, and detonates them after Nickes surrenders the cards to save Jispa.

name: Binolt
description: A Blacklist Hunter turned wanted serial killer who stalks Biscuit, Gon, and Killua in the Greed Island badlands, planning to slice them to ribbons. He fights with a pair of scissors and learns everything about a victim by eating their hair, which is how he discovers Biscuit's real age and strength. Beaten in a single blow, he becomes the boys' dodging dummy for two weeks and leaves the game vowing to turn himself in.

name: List
description: A short, freckled, ever-polite Hunter who is one of the Game Masters of Greed Island and lives in the castle at Limeiro with Dwun. He welcomes Gon after the final card is won and reveals that the game's title spells out the creators' initials, with himself as the L. A friend of Ging, he later attends the Chairman Election beside Dwun and gleefully points Ging out to Gon in the hall.

name: Dwun
description: A chain-smoking Game Master of Greed Island whose castle room is a garbage dump, so that presenting the last card, Ruler's Blessing, means digging it out of the trash. Born Wdwune, he still grumbles that Ging changed his name in under a minute to get a D for the title, even though his health, luck, and love life improved afterward. Quick to anger and just as quick to cool down, he remains Ging's loyal friend.

name: Eta
description: A silver-haired Game Master of Greed Island and Elena's twin, who greets every newcomer on arrival and recites the rules with machine-like precision. She delivers Ging's message to Gon, flags the Phantom Troupe as intruders when they sail toward the island, and hosts the hundred-question quiz whose prize is the final card, Ruler's Blessing. Her name supplies one of the two Es in the game's title.

name: Elena
description: A Game Master of Greed Island and Eta's twin, who works from the tower at the port and handles everyone leaving the game. She warns Killua that departing costs him his cards, and after Gon wins she registers his three chosen cards, Paladin's Necklace, Blue Planet, and Plot of Beach, onto his ring. On Ging's orders she rigs Gon's exit so Accompany leads to Kite instead of his father, and privately feels sorry for him.

name: Zetsk Bellam
description: The hulking, caveman-faced half of the Bellam brothers, a pair of Hunters who enter Greed Island alongside Gon and Killua and refuse to work with anyone else. Perceptive enough to sense several spies the moment he arrives, he is violent, trusts only his brother Gashta, and snickers as they challenge Gon's team to a winner-take-all match after the quiz. Gon and Killua flatten them, and both brothers later vote in the Chairman Election.

name: Puhat
description: A big-headed, sharp-eyed Greed Island applicant who befriends Gon and Killua at Tsezguerra's test by working out how many players will be hired. He talks with his eyes closed and his hands moving, is very sure of his own logic, and joins Nickes' alliance once Genthru promises to remove spells. When the bombs appear, he tries to bargain with Genthru alone in Battera's mansion and is killed for it.

name: Hanse
description: A dark-skinned, thick-browed Greed Island player who leads a three-man team with Wong Li and Zeho and brings it into Kazsule's alliance against the Bombers. He casts List to check whether Tree of Plenty can still be monopolized, and turns anxious on learning that Genthru already touched him and planted a bomb. He protests when weapons are allowed in Razor's boxing match, and his team dies soon after leaving the lighthouse.

name: Wong Li
description: A member of Hanse's three-man team who joins Kazsule's alliance in Greed Island. Because his team has already visited Soufrabi, he is the one who casts Accompany and carries all fifteen players to the pirates' town. Like Hanse, he is shaken to learn that Genthru's touch has left a bomb on his leader. He watches the alliance lose every sports trial to Razor's crew, and the Bombers kill him after it disbands.

name: Yabibi
description: An elderly, balding Greed Island player in a hoodie who leads a two-man team with Montreux and joins Kazsule's alliance. Calm and cautious, he objects to Asta's plan to rob the Bombers by force before anyone knows their abilities and suggests using List to find a card worth monopolizing. He cannot even follow the pirate boxer's teleporting uppercut. Genthru's trio kills him and Montreux soon after the alliance breaks up.

name: Amana
description: A quiet, observant Greed Island player on Asta's team, her dark hair combed over one eye, who helps end Asta's argument with Killua by offering two S-rank cards for information. She casts Guidepost to place Plot of Beach in Soufrabi and is the first to deduce that the pirate quest unlocked only because fifteen players arrived by Accompany. Her name later goes dark in Gon's binder after the Bombers kill the alliance.

name: Asta
description: A short-tempered, prideful Greed Island player who leads her own team and joins Kazsule's alliance. She scorns Gon's group as amateurs and bickers with Killua over the price of information about the Bomber, then pays two S-rank cards and shares her own tricks in return. After the alliance loses to Razor's pirates she convinces most of the others to disband, reasoning the Bombers cannot win either, and Genthru kills her team soon after.

name: Motaricke
description: A timid, overthinking Greed Island player who has spent years inside the game and trails Gon and Killua after their first tournament win, agonizing over robbing children before telling himself he must provide for his wife. His Thief card fizzles against the boys' precautions. Months later the Bombers capture him, make him roll Risky Dice and cast Lottery on their behalf, and disguise him as one of them to ambush Tsezguerra's team.

name: Jeet
description: A tall, spiky-haired Greed Island player who is the first to show Tsezguerra his Ren and the first applicant to pass, entering the game in the same batch as Gon and Killua. He smirks at the boys by the tournament board in Antokiba, then minutes later lies dead in the street with his stomach blown open, the first Bomber victim they witness. Biscuit later counts him among the deaths the boys narrowly dodged.

name: Bopobo
description: A huge, brash pirate in Razor's crew at Soufrabi, in truth a death-row convict serving his sentence inside Greed Island. He challenges players to sumo inside a ring of fire, crushes Zeho, then loses when Killua splashes liquor on his face and sets it alight. Petty and vengeful, he keeps demanding a rematch, and when he hints that the island is real and turns on Razor, Razor kills him on the spot.

name: Gashta Bellam
description: The leader of the Bellam brothers, a famous two-man team of Hunters who enter Greed Island in Gon and Killua's batch and never team up with anyone else. He senses onlookers the moment he arrives and calmly decides they are no threat. Feared by other players and marked as troublesome by the Bombers, he and Zetsk challenge Gon's team to a winner-take-all match after the quiz, and lose badly.

name: Zeho
description: The brawn of Hanse's team in Kazsule's alliance, an Enhancer confident in his strength who volunteers to face the pirate Bopobo at sumo. Killua notes that he takes far too long to charge a weak Ren, and Bopobo crushes him and dangles his foot in the flames until Gon steps in. He sits out the rest of Razor's trials, leaves with his team, and is killed by Genthru shortly after.

name: Montreux
description: Yabibi's partner in Kazsule's alliance, a self-confident Greed Island player who marvels that Gon's team owns Wild Luck Alexandrite and casts List to confirm nobody holds Plot of Beach. An Emitter, he fires aura projectiles from his fists and volunteers for Razor's boxing trial when he sees the ring favors his type. He declares himself the better Nen user right before a teleporting uppercut knocks him out cold.

name: Jispa
description: A founding member of Nickes' alliance in Greed Island, the courier who ferries new recruits to the hideout with Magnetic Force and Accompany while lecturing them on the card system. When Genthru reveals himself as the Bomber, Jispa is the only member who tries to attack him, and Little Flower tears his face open. His bomb's timer runs fastest, and Nickes surrenders the alliance's cards to try to save him.

name: Manheim
description: A laid-back member of Asta's team in Kazsule's alliance and the calm counterweight to his hot-tempered leader. With Amana he settles the standoff between Asta and Killua by offering two S-rank cards for the truth about the Bomber. In Soufrabi he suggests the townsfolk stayed silent because some hidden condition had not yet been met. He loses to Razor's pirates with the rest and dies alongside his team.

name: Kite
description: Kite is a Hunter and the prized student of Ging Freecss; a chance childhood encounter with him is what set Gon on the path to becoming a Hunter. A consummate professional specializing in biological surveys, he conjures a random weapon with his ability Crazy Slots. He reunites with Gon and Killua at the start of the Chimera Ant arc, and his fate drives much of that story.

name: Morel Mackernasey
name_ja: モラウ＝マッカーナーシ
description: Morel Mackernasey is a Single-Star Sea Hunter and a core member of the Chimera Ant Extermination Team, as well as the master of Knuckle Bine and Shoot McMahon. A burly veteran with a wry sense of humor, he fights with a giant smoking pipe, shaping its smoke into constructs and clones with remarkable tactical versatility. He mentors the younger Hunters while anchoring the assault on the Ant-occupied kingdom.

name: Knov
description: A veteran Hunter and an elite member of the extermination team sent into NGL to combat the Chimera Ants. A dapper, bespectacled man, he works alongside Morel Mackernasey and is the mentor of Palm Siberia. His Nen ability, Hide and Seek, opens portals into a four-dimensional mansion of his own making, making him the team's key infiltrator and logistics man.

name: Meruem
description: Meruem is the most powerful offspring of the Chimera Ant Queen, born as the King of the Chimera Ants, and the main antagonist of the Chimera Ant arc. Endowed with overwhelming strength and intellect from birth, he initially views humanity with contempt as mere livestock. His encounters with the blind Gungi prodigy Komugi gradually complicate his understanding of human worth.

name: Neferpitou
description: Neferpitou, nicknamed Pitou, is a cat-humanoid Chimera Ant and the firstborn of the King's three Royal Guards. Playful in demeanor but utterly ruthless, they possess immense aura and a talent for Nen that alarms even veteran Hunters. Their fierce loyalty to the King drives everything they do, from defending the palace to healing at his command.

name: Shaiapouf
description: Shaiapouf, nicknamed Pouf, is a butterfly-humanoid Chimera Ant and one of the King's three Royal Guards. Eloquent, artistic, and outwardly composed, he idolizes the King as a perfect ruler and grows increasingly unstable when reality threatens that ideal. He schemes behind the scenes to keep the King on what he considers the proper path.

name: Menthuthuyoupi
description: Menthuthuyoupi, nicknamed Youpi, is a Chimera Ant and the youngest of the King's three Royal Guards. Born from a magical beast rather than a human, he is the least humanlike of the three, a straightforward fighter of colossal strength who can freely reshape his own body. During the palace invasion he squares off against multiple Hunters at once and evolves mid-battle.

name: Chimera Ant Queen
description: A mutated Chimera Ant Queen, two meters tall, who washes ashore in NGL and begins eating humans to breed a King. Through phagogenesis she passes the traits of everything she eats to her offspring, producing soldiers with human minds and speech. She names the Royal Guards herself and dies when the King tears his way out early, using her last breath to name him Meruem.

name: Knuckle Bine
description: Knuckle Bine is a Beast Hunter and one of Morel Mackernasey's two apprentices. A hot-blooded brawler with a pompadour and a delinquent's exterior, he is in truth deeply softhearted, prone to tears over strays and fallen comrades alike. He tests Gon and Killua as a gatekeeper to the extermination mission and later fights on the front line of the palace invasion.

name: Shoot McMahon
description: Shoot McMahon is an Unidentified Beast Hunter, Knuckle Bine's partner, and a disciple of Morel Mackernasey. Quiet and self-effacing, he struggles with timidity and a fear of battle that he resolves to overcome during the Chimera Ant crisis. He fights using three floating disembodied hands and a levitating cage, and serves alongside Knuckle in testing Gon and Killua and in the palace invasion.

name: Palm Siberia
description: A probationary Hunter and the apprentice of Sea Hunter Morel Mackernasey. Intense and emotionally volatile yet deeply devoted, she is introduced when Gon and Killua must win her approval to join the Chimera Ant mission. Her clairvoyant Nen makes her one of the team's most valuable scouts, and she undergoes one of the arc's most striking transformations.

name: Komugi
description: Komugi is the blind World Gungi Champion, a frail young woman who has devoted her entire life to the board game Gungi and has never lost a match. Brought to the palace to entertain the Chimera Ant King, her guileless nature and unbeatable play form an unlikely bond with him that becomes the emotional heart of the arc. She wields extraordinary unconscious talent despite having no combat ability whatsoever.

name: Ikalgo
description: An octopus-shaped Chimera Ant and captain in Leol's squad who ambushes Killua from inside a stolen corpse, then switches sides after Killua calls him cool. An Enhancer, he snipes with Fleadom, firing living fleas from a rifle-like arm, and pilots dead bodies with Living Dead Dolls to infiltrate the palace. He would rather have been born a squid, and cannot stand being called an octopus.

name: Meleoron
description: A chameleon-like Squadron Leader who hates fighting and abandons the nest after the newborn King kills Peggy, his foster father from his human life. A Specialist, he turns invisible at will and, with Perfect Plan and God's Accomplice, erases himself and anyone holding his breath from every sense. He chain-smokes, feigns indifference, and quietly becomes Gon's most trusted partner in the palace raid.

name: Welfin
description: A wolf-like Squadron Leader who defects to the King's palace and schemes to rule from the shadows through the Secretary of State, Bizeff. A Conjurer, his Missileman implants centipedes in anyone who lies to him. Paranoid and cunning, he shadows Ikalgo and Hina through the invasion, then, cornered by Meruem, gasps out the name Komugi and regains his human memories.

name: Bloster
description: A lobster-like Squadron Leader with heavy claws who leaves the nest, tears through a police squad, and pledges himself to the King in East Gorteau. An Emitter, he fires rapid bursts of aura from his pincers, a power granted by Shaiapouf. Blunt and suspicious, he blasts Ikalgo's borrowed Flutter body to pieces the moment it calls Leol by the wrong name.

name: Zazan
description: A vain, scorpion-tailed Squadron Leader who leaves the nest to crown herself queen of Meteor City. A Manipulator, her Queen Shot stinger mutates humans into loyal beasts that build her palace. When half the Phantom Troupe comes home to clear her out, she duels Feitan, sheds her skin into a monstrous form, and pushes him into unleashing Rising Sun.

name: Colt
description: A condor-like Squadron Leader, the Queen's most loyal and the only one who follows her orders to the letter. Born from Kurt, a boy killed protecting his sister, he blurts out the name Reina without knowing why. After the King's birth he surrenders to Morel and Knov to beg help for the dying Queen, then raises her last child as his own.

name: Cheetu
description: A cheetah-like Squadron Leader obsessed with being the fastest thing alive, who ditches the nest to become the Speed King and torments police for sport. A Conjurer taught by Shaiapouf, he traps opponents in Tag, a game of chase inside a private realm. Too simple to plan ahead, he is shaken by Knuckle's A.P.R. and ends up outrun by Silva and Zeno Zoldyck.

name: Leol
description: A lion-like Squadron Leader, first known as Hagya, who hunts humans for fun and leads the exodus from the nest after the King is born. A Specialist, his Rental Pod lets him borrow the Nen ability of anyone who owes him a favor, dispensed from an iPod-like device. Laid back and always listening to music, he drowns in the flood he himself unleashes against Morel.

name: Rammot
description: A rabbit-eared officer in Colt's squad who attacks Gon and Killua for approaching his impaled prey and is the first Chimera Ant to awaken to Nen after nearly dying. An Enhancer, he heals fast and punches open the aura nodes of every Squadron Leader at Neferpitou's ceremony. Vengeful and sadistic, he hunts Killua down, and his death marks the moment Killua removes Illumi's needle.

name: Peggy
description: A penguin-like Squadron Leader, the scholar of the nest, who reads constantly and deduces that humans are killing ants with guns and with something stranger. He organizes the colony's defense with Colt as Netero, Morel and Knov thin the squads outside. When the King is born, he approaches too eagerly and is the first ant Meruem kills, a death that jolts Meleoron's memory of his foster father.

name: Flutter
description: A dragonfly-like officer and Leol's scout, who says only what he must and tracks targets from the sky. Using abilities from Shaiapouf, he conjures Satellitonbo dragonflies and sees through their eyes with Super Eye, directing Ikalgo's sniper shots onto Killua. Knov kills him, and his corpse becomes Ikalgo's disguise inside the palace until Bloster blows it apart.

name: Bihorn
description: A bull-like Squadron Leader, said by Pike to be the strongest of them all, who serves the Queen directly and never leaves her side. He complains that her voice gives him a headache, yet argues fiercely against Hagya's call to abandon the wounded Queen. Among the few who stay, he and Small Bear brief Colt on the exodus and watch her die.

name: Spinner Clow
description: A young Amateur Hunter on Kite's Kakin wildlife survey team, nicknamed Spin, who tracks the Chimera Ant Queen's trail from a severed limb to NGL. She has no Nen, but her research and her ever-present camera do the team's detective work, and she is the one who relays the alarm to the Hunter Association. Serious and quick to scold, she wants a Hunter license to repay Kite for buying her hometown's swan mountain.

name: Bizeff
description: East Gorteau's Secretary of State, the exhausted bureaucrat who actually runs the country and whom the Chimera Ant King spares because nobody else can. No Nen user, he survives on cigarettes, a laptop and a hidden harem beneath the palace, which is exactly how Palm slips inside. Conned by Welfin, dug out of rubble by Hina, he ends up driving the ants' RV toward Meteor City.

name: Hina
description: A cheerful, almost human-looking captain in Leol's squad, once called Hirin, who follows him to the King's palace. A Specialist, she is an Exorcist who removes Nen curses, lifting Knuckle's Hakoware from Cheetu, though the aura she absorbs swells her belly. She frets about her figure, loves baths, and only helps the trapped Bizeff after he promises her the palace treasure.

name: Reina
description: A five-year-old girl from NGL who goes fishing with her older brother Kurt to surprise their mother, only to become, with him, the first humans a crab-like ant delivers to the Chimera Ant Queen. Seen through Kurt's diary and a brief flashback, she adores her brother and wants to marry him someday. Kurt's drive to protect her survives in Colt, who later gives her name to the Queen's last child.

name: Pike
description: A spider-like officer in Zazan's squad, clumsy and devoted to his leader, who captures Pokkle in NGL and later spins the webs that hold her palace together in Meteor City. He fights with sticky thread and Love Shower, a net fired from his rear that he claims even Bihorn could not break. Against Shizuku he is netted the other way, drained of blood by Blinky.

name: Turtle
description: A turtle-like Squadron Leader among the first human-shaped ants the Queen produces. A born flatterer, he interrupts the Queen's summons to ask that the ants be allowed to choose their own names, a request that shapes the whole arc. When the newborn King orders Colt to clean his tail, Turtle offers a handkerchief instead, and is killed and eaten on the spot for it.

name: Yunju
description: A centaur-like Squadron Leader who sets himself up as a king inside a hidden drug factory in NGL, keeping two captured humans as pet dogs. He confronts Gon, Killua and Kite with his soldiers Centipede and Mosquito. He crushes his pets underfoot the moment they annoy him, then takes a single shot from Kite's Crazy Slots to the head.

name: Mosquito
description: A winged soldier in Yunju's squad who challenges Killua inside the drug factory and asks what pet name he would like. She feints with the sting in her mouth to land the real poison in her tail. Poison means nothing to a Zoldyck; Killua twists her head around, and she accepts defeat calmly, blaming only her own weakness.

name: Baro
description: An armadillo-like officer in Leol's squad, drawn by lot to fight Gon one on one in NGL. He curls into a ball and hurls himself like a cannon shot, steering mid-charge with his tail and boasting that a normal person's organs would be splattered. When he confesses he kills purely for pleasure, Gon catches the next charge with Ren and crushes him.

name: Small Beetle
description: A small beetle-like officer under Zazan in Meteor City who refers to himself with the odd pronoun boki. A Manipulator, he plants an antenna on a target and steers it with a handheld game joystick, sending the soldier Pell to grapple Shalnark. Shalnark answers with his own antenna, and Autopilot mode smashes beetle and puppet in one blow.

name: Hollow
description: An owl-like soldier from Meleoron's squad who, with his partner Bat, ambushes Gon at night after the boys split up in East Gorteau. He stuns with aura-charged feather plumes, hears the faintest sounds, and sheds his wings to become a bruiser in Gorilla Mode. Gon breaks their perfect formation by whirling a felled tree, then sends Hollow flying with a punch.

name: Inzagi
description: A wrinkled, fanged peon in Welfin's division, patrolling the East Gorteau palace with Maenole. He can extend blade-like weapons from his arms. The pair report Taragetter's bloody shoes to their irritable leader, then run into Killua during the invasion and lose their heads to his yo-yos in an instant, leaving corpses too mangled for Ikalgo to borrow.

name: Zem
description: A Squadron Leader who grows cocky after Rammot's punch awakens him to Nen, and who is named only in passing as the colony's outer squads vanish into Morel's smoke. Baital orders his unit and Pokoro's into crane formation behind his own, and none report back; the Extermination Team hunts him down off screen before the King is born.

name: Ortho Siblings
description: A brother-and-sister pair of fish-like captains in Leol's squad who guard the underground lake. Conjurers, their shared Dart De Darts turns a badge-marked victim into a living dartboard, each fish dart tearing into the body part it scores. They gleefully rack up points on Killua, who stops the final dart with Whirlwind and beheads them mid-celebration; their severed heads keep bickering.

name: Koala
description: A tuxedoed koala soldier in Meleoron's squad who shoots fleeing humans dead with water from his gourd, then lectures them about their attitude. A hitman in his human life, he kept his memories and simply resumed killing. After the war he finds Kite, confesses to shooting a red-haired girl who looked just like her, and vows to stay by her side in penance.

name: Bat
description: A bat-winged officer from Meleoron's squad who hunts in tandem with Hollow, attacking Gon in the dark after he leaves Killua. She dive-bombs from above and unleashes screeching sonic attacks that paralyze her target while her partner strikes. Cheerful and cocky, she falls for Gon's feint, is deafened by his scream, and is slammed into a rock wall by a whirling tree.

name: Centipede
description: A sixteen-armed soldier in Yunju's squad who takes on Gon inside the NGL drug factory. Confident in his Thousand-Hand Fist, he simulates the fight in his head, planning to sacrifice one row of arms to bite. Gon uses Scissors instead and cuts him in half; Kite finishes him with a bullet and teaches Gon to always crush an ant's head.

name: Alligator
description: An albino, mohawked alligator Squadron Leader in a wrestling singlet, one of the first human-shaped ants the Queen bears. He bickers with Colt over who hauled in more humans and is among the survivors of the Hunters' first purge. Lazy and gluttonous, he sides with Hagya's breakaway, then wanders to the NGL shore declaring himself the Glutton King, in no hurry at all.

name: Small Bear
description: A panda-like Squadron Leader with a cross necklace, one of the first human-shaped ants and one of the few who genuinely cares for the Queen. He stays at her side through the King's birth and her failed surgery, then explains to Morel and Knov that the ants carry human memories, which is why they picked up speech so fast. He and Bihorn brief the returning Colt.

name: Stick Dinner
description: An Amateur Hunter on Kite's survey team who, true to his name, is in charge of dinner. He is one of the few who pass NGL's strict entry screening, riding in with Kite, Gon and Killua before being sent back for help when Ponzu's SOS arrives. Not a Nen user, he brings cheer instead: a big afro, a constant grin and a weakness for puns.

name: Banana Kavaro
description: A cordial Amateur Hunter on Kite's team who carries a tracking dog in her backpack and shows Gon and Killua footage of the Camp Tiger cooking its meat. She has no Nen but knows Chimera Ant biology cold, explaining to her teammates how a Queen's colony grows and what a King would mean. Kept out of NGL by the border screening, she later helps ferry Netero, Morel and Knov to the border.

name: Lin Koshi
description: A short, brainy Amateur Hunter on Kite's team who logged exactly 1,019 new species during three years surveying the Kakin Empire. He has no Nen; his contribution is analysis, first judging the auctioned specimen an impossibly large insect leg and later briefing his teammates on Chimera Ant hierarchy. Rabbit-toothed and candid, he stutters the first word of every sentence he speaks.

name: Podungo Lapoy
description: The smallest member of Kite's survey team, an Amateur Hunter and skilled chemist. She stays behind to analyze the strange limb bought by the Southernpiece Auction House and phones Kite with the verdict that starts the whole crisis: it belongs to a Chimera Ant Queen. Not a Nen user, she still passes NGL's screening and rides in with Kite, then is sent back with Stick to summon help.

name: Monta Yuras
description: A big, koala-faced Amateur Hunter on Kite's team, nicknamed Mon, who hauls the group's luggage and suggests hunting smaller creatures to fill out their contract. He has no Nen and little to say, usually just a jovial smile. His moment comes when Spin screams at Killua for abandoning Kite: Mon grabs the phone and, though shaken, calmly tells the boys to wait, help is on the way.

name: Ming Jol-ik
description: The Supreme Leader of East Gorteau, called Diego in the anime, a revolutionary who seized the country and then quietly retired thirty years ago, leaving a body double to rule. Neither man uses Nen; the double's pompous titles earn him instant death from Meruem, and Neferpitou puppets his corpse to broadcast the national rally. The real man surfaces only at the end, raising a glass to the creature called man.

name: Marcos
description: A military leader in East Gorteau's regime who trades everything he knows for asylum abroad for himself and his family. He has no Nen, but his access is a weapon: he feeds Morel and Knov military intelligence, reports the coup rumors and mass graves behind them, and smuggles Palm into the palace disguised as one of Bizeff's 'meat' deliveries. Morel thanks him aloud while privately noting he carried out the atrocities himself.

name: Gyro
description: The founder and king of NGL, the back-to-nature nation that secretly fronts his drug cartel. Drawn only as a silhouette, he is a human with no Nen, just a brilliant mind, a charisma that outlasts death and a childhood of beatings that left him hating all humanity. Eaten by the ants, he is reborn keeping every memory, ignores the Queen and walks away; Welfin still hopes to find him.

name: Kurt
description: A nine-year-old boy from a village in NGL who lives with his mother Haruna and his little sister Reina. His diary entries open the arc: fishing trips, a snake fought off, a vow to protect Reina until she finds a worthy husband. No Nen, just a fishing rod, which he swings at the crab-like Chimera Ant that kills them both. His protectiveness survives him, reborn in the ant Colt.

name: Shidore
description: A tiny Chimera Ant peon in a cream dress who follows Hina silently and, rare for her rank, understands human speech. She has no Nen, only a child's loyalty, and a past: she is Reina, the little girl from NGL eaten alongside her brother Kurt. Fleeing the palace, she and Hina haul Bizeff from the rubble; later Bloster walks her home, where her mother recognizes her at once.

name: Haruna
description: A single mother in a small NGL village whose two children, Kurt and Reina, vanish on a fishing trip, the first humans the Chimera Ant Queen devours. She has no Nen and no part in the fighting; she appears in Colt's fragments of memory and in her own grief. Then a small ant in a dress walks into the village, and Haruna knows her daughter on sight and holds her.

name: Alluka Zoldyck
description: One of Killua's younger siblings, kept isolated by the Zoldyck Family because of Nanika, the mysterious being dwelling within Alluka. Nanika's wish-granting power can accomplish nearly anything, but it operates under strict and dangerous rules of escalating requests. Killua, who loves Alluka dearly, seeks that power's help during the Chairman Election arc, defying the rest of the family to do so.

name: Nanika
description: The pitch-black-eyed 'something' living inside Alluka Zoldyck, surfacing whenever someone grants three of Alluka's requests in a row. It then grants one wish of seemingly limitless scale, healing Gon's ruined body or teleporting Illumi home, but refusing the next requests four times kills people, more with each bigger wish. It adores Killua, asks only to be petted, and sobs when he orders it never to come out again.

name: Pariston Hill
description: The Rat of the Zodiacs and Netero's Vice Chairman, a perpetually smiling Triple-Star Hunter whose charm hides a taste for chaos. He runs a Temp Hunter agency, controls the review board, and enters the Chairman Election with a third of the vote already in his pocket. He insists he only wants to toy with people, treats the whole race as a game, and reserves his one real rivalry for Ging.

name: Cheadle Yorkshire
name_ja: チードル＝ヨークシャー
description: The Dog of the Zodiacs, a Triple-Star Disease Hunter who is also a doctor and a lawyer, and the sharpest procedural mind in the Association. Fiercely loyal to Netero and openly disgusted by Pariston, she runs for Chairman on a promise to expel corruption. Her Nen is never shown; her weapon is the rulebook. When the numbers turn against her, she throws her support behind Leorio.

name: Mizaistom Nana
description: The Ox of the Zodiacs, a Double-Star Crime Hunter who manages a private security firm and practices law on the side. Calm, methodical and dubbed the group's conscience, he is the first to accuse Pariston over the Hunters who vanished during his term. He quits the Chairman race to consolidate the anti-Pariston vote, only to hear Pariston praise him as the best candidate. The others just call him Mizai.

name: Kanzai
description: The Tiger of the Zodiacs, a hot-headed Treasure Hunter in a yellow baseball uniform with tiger-striped hair and a shorter fuse than anyone at the table. He lunges at Pariston more than once and has to be held back by four colleagues at a time. Hisoka quietly rates his strength at 85, yet he cannot spell "election" and gets his grammar corrected by Cheadle mid-meeting.

name: Ginta
description: The Sheep of the Zodiacs, a huge, shaggy Poacher Hunter and ranger who arrives at the first election meeting sobbing over Netero's death. His grief flips instantly to rage when Pariston proposes skipping the vote, and he threatens to kill him on the spot. Fast despite his bulk, he plants himself in Kanzai's path before the Tiger can take a step, and later guards the auditorium doors beside Saccho.

name: Saccho Kobayakawa
name_ja: サッチョウ＝コバヤカワ
description: The Horse of the Zodiacs, a Double-Star Problem Hunter and detective with a long horse face, two buck teeth and a pair of katanas tucked into his purple yukata. Calm where his colleagues shout, he quietly works out the real odds behind Cheadle's lottery and prefers to operate behind the scenes. Eliminated in the fifth round, he pledges to keep supporting the Association from the shadows.

name: Botobai Gigante
description: The Dragon of the Zodiacs, a Triple-Star Terrorist Hunter, public prosecutor and military analyst who serves as the group's advisor. Steadfastly loyal to Netero, he still resents that the Chairman took Morel and Knov to fight the Chimera Ants instead of the Zodiacs. He sits in the top four through the early rounds, drops out in the seventh, and asks everyone who voted for him to back Cheadle.

name: Pyon
description: The Rabbit of the Zodiacs, a Paleograph Hunter, linguist and programmer who attends every meeting in bunny ears with a phone or laptop in hand. Breezy and blunt, she needles Pariston as the "Prince of Kickbacks" and serves as MC for the all-Hunter assembly. When Leorio's remote punch sends Ging flying, she gleefully reminds the room that the whole thing will be posted on the Hunter Website.

name: Saiyu
description: The Monkey of the Zodiacs, a Blacklist Hunter and martial artist as blunt as they come, happy to call Ging a truant and Pariston a scumbag to their faces. A Conjurer, he materializes a long priest staff and uses it to pin Kanzai down when the Tiger lunges at Pariston. He places a humble 35th round after round, and after his elimination stays on as a poll monitor.

name: Gel
description: The Snake of the Zodiacs, a Poison Hunter, coroner and pharmacist who watches the election debates with cool detachment. She saves her venom for Pariston: when he proposes skipping the election, her arm transforms into a hissing snake as she tells him none of them would ever vote for him. Her Nen type is never named. After her elimination she serves as a poll inspector alongside Mizaistom and Saiyu.

name: Cluck
description: The Chicken of the Zodiacs, a Botanical Hunter who moonlights as a dancer and musician and has no patience for anyone in the room. She complains that Ginta is loud and smelly, snaps at Pariston at every turn, and yells "shut up" whenever things drag on. Her flock of pigeons carries the election notices to more than six hundred Hunters. Her Nen type is never named.

name: Tsubone
description: A veteran Zoldyck butler, a broad, monocled grandmother whom Silva trusts to escort Killua and Alluka off the mountain and haul Killua home the instant he breaks the rules. A Conjurer, her ability Rider's High turns her body into a motorcycle or glider that her granddaughter Amane pilots on her aura. Alone among the staff she calls him 'Killua-chan', and she tears out her own fingernails for Alluka with a smile.

name: Amane
description: Tsubone's granddaughter and a young Zoldyck butler, sent with her grandmother to shadow Killua and Alluka and to seize Alluka the moment Killua strays more than a meter from her. A Nen user with no ability of her own shown, she feeds aura into Tsubone's vehicle forms and drives them, motorcycle or glider, at speeds beyond Killua's Godspeed. Haughty and stiff, she is flustered to pieces when Canary calls her cute.

name: Maha Zoldyck
description: The oldest living Zoldyck, a tiny, wizened great-great-grandfather who is spoken of long before he is seen: the tour guide counts him among the assassins on Kukuroo Mountain, and Zeno recalls that Netero is the only man to fight him and survive. An Enhancer, he still takes jobs for the family business. He appears only briefly, as a face in Killua's map of family loyalties.

name: Loupe Highland
description: A bespectacled Lost Hunter who specializes in tracking down missing persons, and the quiet strategist of the trio that revives Netero's old Pure Paladin Squad. He serves as deputy under Teradein, votes for him on air, and proposes hiring Temp Hunters as bait to drain Pariston's support. He judges Teradein too honest and Bushidora too careless, and he is the one who reports the squad's massacre back to Teradein.

name: Teradein Neutral
name_ja: テラデイン＝ニュートラル
description: A silver-haired Double-Star Head Hunter, a talent scout who wants to reform the Hunter Exam and briefly becomes the election's candidate of conscience. After Morel asks for help against Illumi's Needle People, he revives the Pure Paladin Squad, Netero's old unit, with Loupe and Bushidora and broadcasts a joint appeal for votes. His crusade ends when Hisoka walks into his office and kills him.

name: Bushidora Ambitious
name_ja: ブシドラ＝アンビシャス
description: A Single-Star Blacklist Hunter on the Association's disciplinary committee, dressed in a flame-trimmed coat and police cap, who campaigns to rewrite the Hunter Bylaws. He names himself captain of the revived Pure Paladin Squad's field force and gives up his own candidacy so Teradein can collect the votes. Boastful and distrustful of amateurs, he leads his men straight into Hisoka and is slaughtered along with them.

name: Sanbica Norton
description: A Single-Star Virus Hunter and doctor who is never seen without her gown, gloves and surgical mask. Timid to the point of stammering, she is horrified to find herself among the top sixteen candidates and asks people to stop voting for her. She loses in the fifth round, which is exactly what she wanted, and still thanks her supporters in a shy concession speech.

name: Ickshonpe Katocha
name_ja: イックションペ＝カットゥーチャ
description: A Single-Star Hacker Hunter who never speaks, hides behind a grinning white mask and communicates only in writing. He places third in the opening rounds without campaigning and abstains from voting himself. When his turn to speak arrives, he writes that the election is not his reality, then asks Ging whether he would trade the White Spear of Glory for the Holy Golden Flag.

name: Cutie Beauty
name_ja: キューティー＝ビューティー
description: A Single-Star Cute Hunter and Pariston's self-declared head groupie, whose entire platform is a cuter Hunter Association. Introduced in Beans' broadcast of the top sixteen candidates, she rides Pariston's popularity into the fifth round, which is where her campaign ends. Her concession speech insists that the dream of a Cute Association will live on through her respected colleague Pariston. Her Nen is never seen.
